root_cause_clusters.RC_CLAIM: Claim path does not fence on an active foreign lease_until.
root_cause_clusters.RC_SIGN: HMAC canonical string uses the wrong field separator / omits timestamp.
root_cause_clusters.RC_QUOTA: Quota counts all delivery attempts instead of successful deliveries in the rolling hour.
root_cause_clusters.RC_REPLAY_AUTH: DLQ replay ignores OUTBOX_TOKEN and never returns unauthorized.
root_cause_clusters.RC_AUDIT: Audit writer drops claim and dlq actions.
root_cause_clusters.RC_UI: UI claim posts wrong JSON fields and does not surface API errors.
root_cause_clusters.RC_PAUSE: Paused endpoints still allow new claims.

defects.observable_failure: Second claim by a different owner while lease is active returns 200 instead of 409 lease_held.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Rejecting all second claims including same-owner renewals breaks legitimate renewals.

defects.observable_failure: Two workers can both hold claimed status for the same event id concurrently.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Serializing only in the UI still leaves the API race open.

defects.observable_failure: Non-holder complete can succeed if a racing second claim overwrote lease_owner.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking holder without lease fencing still allows overwrite races.

defects.observable_failure: X-Outbox-Signature does not verify against id\ntimestamp\nbody HMAC-SHA256.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Signing only the body without timestamp still fails the contract verifier.

defects.observable_failure: Canonical string joins fields with '|' instead of newline separators.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Changing separator but still omitting timestamp fails verification.

defects.observable_failure: Timestamp header is present but not included in the HMAC message.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hashing id+body only looks close but fails sink verification.

defects.observable_failure: Receivers validating the documented canonical form reject every delivery.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Marking complete without HTTP still skips signature checks.

defects.observable_failure: Failed attempts consume deliveries_per_hour budget.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Raising tenant quota hides the wrong counter until load returns.

defects.observable_failure: Enqueue returns 429 after failures even when zero successful deliveries exist in the hour.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Counting only pending events still diverges from attempt outcomes.

defects.observable_failure: Successful delivery path uses CountAllAttemptsSince rather than successful deliveries.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Caching an in-memory counter that resets on restart breaks persistence.

defects.observable_failure: POST replay without Authorization succeeds while OUTBOX_TOKEN is configured.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking token only on pause leaves replay open.

defects.observable_failure: Wrong bearer token still returns 200 pending for dlq events.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Accepting any non-empty Authorization header still bypasses equality.

defects.observable_failure: Unauthorized replay never emits HTTP 401 unauthorized.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Returning 403 without the contract error string fails tests.

defects.observable_failure: GET /api/v1/audit has no claim action after a successful claim.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Logging claim only to stderr leaves the audit table empty.

defects.observable_failure: Transition into dlq does not write a dlq audit row.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing deliver.fail only is insufficient for the dlq action requirement.

defects.observable_failure: Audit writer early-returns for claim and dlq actions.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Enabling only claim still leaves dlq silent and vice versa.

defects.observable_failure: Claim form posts owner/seconds instead of lease_owner/lease_seconds.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Alias both field sets in the API hides the UI contract break.

defects.observable_failure: API error responses are not written to #error-box.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Alert() popups are not the required error-box surface.

defects.observable_failure: Failed claim leaves error-box empty so operators see a silent failure.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Clearing the box on success only still hides failures.

defects.observable_failure: POST claim succeeds while endpoint.paused is true.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Blocking enqueue on pause still allows claims on already queued events.

defects.observable_failure: Paused flag is stored but Acquire ignores ep.Paused.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking paused only in the worker loop leaves direct API claims open.

defects.observable_failure: lease_held is never returned from the claim API in the starter.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Mapping all conflicts to invalid_status masks the fencing rule.

defects.observable_failure: A single success fills quota incorrectly when prior failures inflated the attempt counter.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Resetting attempt_count on events does not fix attempt-table counting.

defects.observable_failure: Signature hex matches an alternate canonicalization unknown to receivers.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Documenting the wrong formula in comments without code change fails sinks.

defects.observable_failure: Replay audit may be written even when auth should have blocked the mutation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Authorizing after the state change leaves an illegal pending event.

cross_component: failed attempts must not exhaust quota
pause blocks claim but not historical enqueue
